summary.title: Lab3 Small WLAN
summary.description:
A small home/office WLAN consisting of one modem, one Wi-Fi router/access point, two laptops, one smartphone, a network printer and a NAS file server, connected to the Internet via an ISP.

Assets: router/AP, router firmware and configuration, router admin credentials, Wi-Fi passphrase, client devices, NAS and stored files, user data and credentials, network traffic, and the Internet connection.

Assumptions: WPA2-PSK is used with a single shared passphrase, all users share one SSID, and the router uses default settings unless stated otherwise.
